candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Personalized Synthetic Long Peptide Vaccine: Personalized Synthetic Long Peptide Vaccine

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients who are within 6 months of diagnosis and have detectable disease as determined by investigator assessment at the start of vaccine administration.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Immune monitoring is defined as the percentage of patients showing an immune response to the vaccine components.

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Personalized Synthetic Long Peptide Vaccine: Personalized Synthetic Long Peptide Vaccine

coder_notes: Multi-cohort solid-tumour vaccine study; glioblastoma is named only as a cohort heading in the eligibility text (no conditions entry, single registered arm). Treatment setting of the GBM cohort is 'within 6 months of diagnosis' with no statement on prior therapy, so unclear. Other cohorts (pancreatic, basket) mention NTRK/RET/MSI-H/BRCA only as grounds to consider approved therapies, not as entry requirements. Immunogenicity (ELISpot) is the planned pharmacodynamic readout of the vaccine.
